projects.name: Load Balancer
projects.action: A Layer-7 HTTP load balancer in Go spreading traffic across servers behind a single endpoint, with round-robin, least-connections, and latency-based power-of-two-choices routing driven by live in-flight counts and response times. Lock-free request path, active health checks, graceful shutdown, async SQLite logging, and a Next.js live dashboard. Tested with 600 requests against slow, fast, and 10%-failing mock servers.
projects.impact: Latency-based routing hit 1,932 req/s at 1.3ms median, 10x round-robin throughput

projects.name: Smart Bookmark
projects.action: A bookmark manager that syncs across your devices. Uses Google Gemini so you can search your bookmarks with plain English queries. Jina AI scrapes pages into clean text before indexing. Has collections, favourites, a trash bin with 30-day recovery, and Google OAuth for sign-in.
projects.impact: AI-powered semantic search with Google Gemini integration

projects.name: Academia
projects.action: A student management app with three-tier role-based access across attendance, timetables, and exam results, backed by Node.js. Includes a progress dashboard, student profiles, and a notifications and events page surfacing updates to the right audience.
projects.impact: Three-tier RBAC serving admins, teachers, and students

projects.name: GitHub Commit Report
projects.action: Turns any GitHub user's commits into a plain-language daily summary with Groq. Skips already-reported commits via history in Google Sheets, routes the draft to Telegram for one-tap approval, and emails the confirmed version.
projects.impact: Approval-gated daily summaries with Sheets-backed dedup

highlights: Led end-to-end development of the Production Plan, collaborating with supply chain, technology, and finance teams across 7 facilities processing 1,000+ orders daily across 2,700+ SKUs. Secured with JWT authentication and action-, facility-, and role-based access controls.

Prioritises daily orders with escalated orders ranked first, assigns them across facilities, and generates serial and batch numbers for batches of 300-500 orders, tracking each through work-in-progress, vacuum completion, and dispatch.

Generates batch-specific MRP labels with QC markings for the production floor, flagging escalated orders for priority handling and repeat quality checks; BOM-based foam allocation suggestions plus scrap tracking keep raw-material use traceable.

Gates QC and dispatch on production state: only work-in-progress orders enter QC, only vacuum-complete orders dispatch; cancellation, shipper-weight, and shipper-allocation checks cutting wasted dispatches.
Batch-based Goods Receipt Notes (GRNs) with QR-scan driven raw-material consumption and UUID-based QR label generation.
BullMQ workers sync Unicommerce inventory and log per-order raw-material consumption from Bills of Materials; a Production Plan trigger ingests eligible mattress orders and updates changed ones.
Vendor Replenishment plus a standalone Vendor App supporting inward processing with QR labels.

3PL warehouse stock dashboard with trend graphs, norm-based out-of-stock and over-limit flags, vendor activity tracking, and automatic reordering at Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ), helping reduce stock-outs.
